More chaos, more laughs, and a whole new set of challenges await!

notes.title: 🧩 New Level in the Works!
notes.notes:
We’ve been listening to all your feedback 🎧
We know the current playtime is short, but we had to release the game at this stage to keep development moving forward.

Now for the good news: A brand-new level is in development!

💡 Thanks to your support, we’re able to add it for free.
We’re truly grateful for all the love, comments, and encouragement ❤️

Stay tuned—more chaotic fun is on the way!

notes.title: Puppet Team is Out Now!
notes.notes:
The strings are officially in your hands!

Ready to control one character with two players?
Puppet Team is now live on Steam—packed with teamwork, chaos, and laugh-out-loud missions!

🧠 One player controls the right limbs, the other the left.
😅 Coordination is key, fun is guaranteed!

🔗 Play now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3030360/Puppet_Team/

Grab a friend and get tangled in the madness!

notes.title: About No Licence Error
notes.notes:
Hello, we are aware of the no license error that appears when you try to enter the game. The problem is not caused by us. We are in contact with Steam to resolve the issue as soon as possible. 

Thank you for your understanding

notes.title: 🎉 Puppet Team is almost here! 🧵
notes.notes:
The wait is almost over! 🎮 Puppet Team is launching in just a few hours!
Take control—or share it—with a friend in this hilarious co-op adventure!

Teamwork, chaos, and laughter await as two players try to control one human character and take on a series of challenging and fun missions together.

🚀 The launch is close! If you haven’t added us to your wishlist yet, now’s the time:
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3030360/Puppet_Team/

Are you ready?
Take control. Let the game begin!

notes.title: 🖐️ New Update: You Can Now Control the Hands! 🧠

Don’t forget to use this new ability in upcoming missions—the strings are in your hands! 👀🧵

🔧 More updates are on the way!

10,000 people are excited for Puppet Team!

If you haven’t already, don’t miss out on this chaotic and hilarious co-op adventure.

notes.title: 🎮 New Update is Live! 🔧
notes.notes:
We’ve made some exciting improvements to enhance your gameplay experience! Here’s what’s new in this version:

🆔 Steam Lobby ID Copy Feature – Easily share your lobby with friends.
⚠️ Error UI Updated – See and track issues more clearly.
🔑 In-Game Key Info – Know what each key does, right inside the game.
⏱️ Time and Death Counter Added – Track how long you played and how many times you died.
🧍‍♂️ "R" Key Character UI – Now there's a UI showing who pressed the R key on a character!

Don’t forget to share your feedback with us. Happy gaming! 🎉

notes.title: 🎉7,000 Wishlists Reached! 🎉
notes.notes:
Puppet Team has officially passed 7,000 wishlists! This is a huge milestone for us — thank you so much for your amazing support! 🙏

If you haven’t already, don’t forget to add us to your Steam wishlist. Every single wishlist helps a lot! 💙

🎯

Thanks again!
— The Puppet Team Devs

notes.title: Sorry All Bugs! New Demo Released
notes.notes:
Dear Puppets,

We are sorry for the bugs you encountered in the latest version of Puppet Team. However, we are happy to inform you that all the issues you are currently seeing have been resolved, and we now offer a much cleaner and more enjoyable gameplay experience. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.

To allow you to experience these improvements, we have released a new demo! Please download and enjoy the improved version of Puppet Team.

Sincerely,

The Puppet Team Team
